name: com.undtec/vin
title: VIN Decoder by Underwriters Technologies
description: Decode a 17-character VIN: year, make, model, engine and plant (NHTSA vPIC). Free, no key.

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decodes a 17-character VIN with the NHTSA vPIC database: year, make, model, trim, body, engine and plant. Missing values mean NHTSA has no data for that field.
